top_findings.title: No MCP protocol server — FastAPI REST implemented instead
top_findings.evidence: server.py:12 from fastapi import FastAPI; HTTP POST endpoints (server.py:422,468,515,571,698) via uvicorn (server.py:813-815); repo-wide grep for mcp/fastmcp/modelcontextprotocol/list_tools/call_tool/stdio_server returns nothing; 'MCP' only free text (server.py:3,360,412).
top_findings.suggestion: Re-implement using an MCP SDK (mcp/fastmcp): expose query functions as registered @tool handlers over stdio transport instead of REST endpoints.
